review_evidence: README identifies the project as a formalization of perfectoid spaces in Lean by Buzzard, Commelin, and Massot.
The hydrated snapshot contains 66 Lean files and direct scan found more than 500 proposition declarations across valuation, topology, power-bounded, and supporting modules.
Files such as src/valuation/canonical.lean and src/power_bounded.lean develop reusable definitions and proofs rather than build or application infrastructure.
summary: Retain lean-perfectoid-spaces as a substantive formalization of perfectoid spaces and supporting valuation/topology theory.
